research.title: Visual Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, removing duplicate captures, and organizing training and evaluation splits by source specimen.
Implemented a prescribed linear support vector machine baseline using gradient descriptors, then inspected classification errors across lighting conditions and defect categories.

research.title: Color and Texture Features for Indoor Scene Recognition
bullets: Standardized indoor image dimensions, checked scene category annotations, and maintained predefined dataset partitions for baseline scene recognition experiments.
Implemented nearest neighbor classification with color histograms and local texture descriptors, comparing feature configurations and documenting confusion between visually similar rooms.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items through established procedures.
Maintained stock records, assembled routine order paperwork, and coordinated pickup schedules with staff to support daily operations.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition with Linear Classifiers
bullets: Implemented a logistic regression baseline for handwritten digit recognition using normalized pixel intensities and predefined training and test partitions.
Compared raw pixels with gradient features under the same evaluation procedure, inspecting confusion patterns and representative misclassified images.
